system.description: An Ooglith Masquer grants a Yuuzhan Vong a +5 Equipment bonus on Deception checks when disguising themselves as a Human. Putting on or removing an Ooglith Masquer requires a Full-Round Action and moves the wearer -3 steps on the Condition Track. (These steps may be recovered normally).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Web Enhancements (Star Wars Miniatures Previews)
